spec.basis: Decoded picture hash SEI message: syntax D.2.20, semantics D.3.20 (H.265 08/2021 table of contents, name-based, text not read); computation as HM TComPicYuvMD5.cpp.

checks.reason: NumPicTotalCurr <= 8 (A.4.1 e), BinCountsInNalUnits (A.4.1 i), the HRD parameters (CpbSize and BitRate of A.4.1 g, h and A.4.2 e, f), the slice segment and tile rate limits of A.4.2 c, d, i, j below their caps, the DPB output intervals (A.4.2 b), sub_layer_level_idc and the VPS profile_tier_level are not evaluated; the rate and compression ratio checks are advisory (assumed 30 fps: the bitstream carries no timing (Annex B has none and the SPS has no VUI timing); every access unit lasting 1 / fps and holding one picture).

spec.basis: Annex A.4 Tiers and levels (Rec. ITU-T H.265 V11 01/2026: A.4.1, A.4.2, Tables A.8-A.10 pp. 262-266; profile indications Tables A.2, A.3 pp. 253, 256).

checks.reason: The SPS carries no hrd_parameters( ) (VUI vui_hrd_parameters_present_flag 0 or no VUI): no buffer model.

spec.basis: Annex C.2 operation of the CPB and C.4 bitstream conformance (Rec. ITU-T H.265 V11 01/2026 pp. 279-286); hrd_parameters E.2.2, BitRate / CpbSize E.3.3; buffering period D.2.2, picture timing D.2.3, AuCpbRemovalDelayVal D.3.3 (pp. 331-332).

checks.reason: Needs the reference decoder: run vca validate --refdec (vca check does not start decoders).
Needs a second decoder: run vca validate --crossdec (vca check does not start decoders).
